notes: FleetComm 1.3.7 — chirps for every key, and Linux. FIX: a talk key bound to a single net (the KEY control on a net row) keyed the net silently — no key-down or key-up chirp and no TX line in the COMM LOG. The chirps now follow the carrier itself, so every way of keying (PTT button, PTT key, per-net key, stick button, open mic) gets exactly one pair. LINUX (experimental): FleetComm now ships as an AppImage and a Flatpak alongside the Windows exe and the Mac zip — download from the release page; Linux has no auto-update yet, you get a banner pointing there. Also riding along since 1.3.4: the Start-menu copy you can pin to the taskbar, the two-minute walkthrough (SYS ▸ HELP), and the helmet-cam wall.
